name: Slag tortoise
description: a large tortoise-like beast of the Ember Wastes made of black cooled slag: a thick plated shell over its whole front half laced with glowing orange cracks, stumpy legs, a small reptilian head, bare and soft at the back

poses.stand: standing on four stumpy legs, a heavy cooled-slag shell like a black plate covering its whole front half, glowing orange cracks in the shell, a small reptilian head peeking over the top, facing right
poses.struck: just hit and flinching: head snapped back, glowing cracks flaring white across the shell, ash falling off
poses.dead: collapsed flat, the shell split in two with a bright lava core spilling out and cooling to black

idle.action: plods in place, its legs treading, orange cracks in the shell pulsing slowly

attack.action: rears its head and spits a slow glob of ember forward to the right, shell glowing brighter

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, shell cracks flaring, then settles

die.action: cracks flare white, the shell splits apart in a burst of embers and the creature slumps and goes dark
